componentDescriptions.textfield: Simple text field for entering short text data like names and addresses
componentDescriptions.textarea: Large text area for entering long text such as comments and descriptions
componentDescriptions.number: Numeric field for numbers and numerical values with range validation capability
componentDescriptions.email: Email field with automatic validation of email format
componentDescriptions.password: Secure password field with hidden text input for data protection
componentDescriptions.file: File upload component for uploading documents, images and other files with size and type validation
componentDescriptions.select: Dropdown list that allows users to choose from predefined options
componentDescriptions.radio: Radio button group for exclusive selection - only one option can be selected
componentDescriptions.checkbox: Checkbox component allowing users to select multiple options simultaneously
componentDescriptions.button: Interactive button for executing actions like submit or reset
componentDescriptions.columns: Create responsive columns to display fields side by side in a grid layout
componentDescriptions.panel: Group related fields together in a collapsible panel with optional title and styling
componentDescriptions.fieldset: Organize form fields into logical groups with borders and optional legend
componentDescriptions.table: Display data in organized table format with rows and columns
componentDescriptions.tabs: Organize content in multiple tabs for better space utilization and navigation
componentDescriptions.well: Create visual container with inset design to highlight content sections
componentDescriptions.htmlelement: Insert custom HTML content and elements for advanced formatting and design
componentDescriptions.content: Add static text, images or rich content that doesn't require user input
componentDescriptions.hidden: Store hidden values invisible to users but included in form submission
componentDescriptions.container: Create grouped container to organize and group multiple components
componentDescriptions.datagrid: Allow users to input multiple rows of organized data in table format
componentDescriptions.editgrid: Provide editable grid interface for managing multiple data entries
componentDescriptions.signature: Capture digital signatures from users using touch or mouse input
componentDescriptions.tagpad: Advanced tag input component for selecting and managing multiple tags
componentDescriptions.reviewpage: Display summary page for users to review form data before submission
componentDescriptions.tree: Hierarchical tree structure for nested data with expand and collapse functionality
componentDescriptions.survey: Comprehensive survey component with multiple question types and ratings
componentDescriptions.resource: Resource component for external data integration and database linking
componentDescriptions.datetime: Date and time selection field with interactive calendar and time tools
componentDescriptions.phoneNumber: Phone number input field with format validation and international code
componentDescriptions.address: Address input field with autocomplete functionality and location detection
componentDescriptions.currency: Financial amount input field with currency formatting and appropriate symbols
